locations.name: Main Entrance
locations.playerDescription: The heavy oak doors of the Red Moon Inn swing open to reveal a warm, inviting common room. The smell of roasting meat and spilled ale fills your nostrils.
locations.gmNotes: The door has a simple lock (Average +20 to pick). At night, a bouncer named Bruno stands guard.

locations.name: The Bar
locations.playerDescription: A long wooden bar runs along the wall, behind which a portly innkeeper polishes tankards with a dirty rag. Rows of bottles and kegs line the shelves.
locations.gmNotes: The innkeeper, Otto Huber, knows all the local gossip. He's willing to share for the price of a few drinks.
hooks: Otto has been receiving threatening letters demanding protection money. He's looking for someone to deal with the problem quietly.

locations.name: Fireplace Corner
locations.playerDescription: A roaring fire crackles in a large stone hearth. Comfortable chairs are arranged around it, occupied by regulars sharing stories.
locations.gmNotes: This is where the local old-timers gather. Perfect for gathering rumors about the city.

locations.name: Private Dining Room
locations.playerDescription: A curtained alcove leads to a private dining room with a single large table. The thick curtains muffle sound from the main room.
locations.gmNotes: This room is often used for clandestine meetings. The walls are thin enough to eavesdrop with a successful Perception test.
hooks: A group of hooded figures meets here every Festag. They speak in hushed tones about 'the ritual.'

locations.name: Staircase
locations.playerDescription: A creaky wooden staircase leads up to the guest rooms on the second floor.
locations.gmNotes: The third step from the top squeaks loudly - a natural alarm for anyone trying to sneak upstairs.

locations.name: Kitchen
locations.playerDescription: Through a swinging door, you can glimpse a busy kitchen where cooks prepare meals and scullions wash dishes.
locations.gmNotes: The back door to the kitchen leads to an alley - a useful escape route.
